en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a broad valley with farms, scattered houses, forested areas and a large lake or fjord. Low mountains rise in the background under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground are cultivated fields and farm buildings. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge, and a cursive photographer or publisher signature appears in the lower right corner.
